I agree to the provision of personalized advertising information.

Your device information (Advertising ID, App Instance ID, and behavioral data) may be shared with and processed by Google through this app.
If you do not consent, your personal information will not be shared with Google without any disadvantage to you.

- Data recipient: Google LLC
- Purpose of processing: Marketing, advertising, and content measurement
- Data provided: Device information (technical identifiers, behavioral data)
* Technical identifiers: Various unique identifiers typically used to identify a computer, device, browser, or application.
 Examples include IP address (may also provide general location), user agent, IDFA (Identifier for Advertisers), Android ID (for Android devices), Google Advertising ID, user-issued ID, and other similar unique identifiers.

Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR (Consent)
Retention period: 14 months

Click here to read the data processor’s privacy policy: (https://policies.google.com/privacy)
You can opt out of sharing your device information with Google at any time from the Settings menu on the main page.
I agree to send advertising-related user data to Google.

We collect and use your usage data through Google to improve service quality and analyze user experience.
- Data recipient: Google LLC
- Purpose of processing: Analysis of website/app usage behavior, traffic and error tracking, and feature improvements
- Data collected: Device information, page visit data, click/scroll activity, session duration, etc.
- Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR (consent)
- Retention period: 14 months

You may use the service without restrictions even if you do not consent to data collection and use through Google.
You can opt out of sharing your device information with Google at any time from the Settings menu on the main page.
We also ask for your consent to collect behavioral data for ad analysis and app improvement.
